subject: Exec Sponsor Dry‑Run & Gating Sprint — final alignment and EB meeting slots
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Exec sponsor dry‑run and gating sprint for Acme close

Team —

Picking up from last week: Acme is asking for a short executive board (EB) validation week that will gate final approvals. They want an EB slot the week of July 5th and would like a dry‑run with sponsors the week prior. High level asks from Acme:

- One 45‑minute EB presentation (execs + Prod Eng)
- A 60‑minute sponsor dry‑run with sponsor + product owners
- A finalized MAP with clear QA/eval checkpoints and success criteria

I attached my first pass at a gating checklist and a MAP draft (MAP_v3.pdf) — please review and flag any technical dependencies that must be resolved before the dry‑run.

Immediate asks:
1) Marissa — can you own the sponsor mapping (who speaks for what agenda item) and produce a one‑page matrix?
2) Karthik — need a short list of mandatory evaluation test cases (3–5) that will be presented to EB as quality gates.
3) Stephanie — coordinate scheduling and confirm availability windows for our EB chairs (prefer three backup times).

I propose we lock the dry‑run for July 1 or 2 and the EB for July 6 (Acme prefers mornings PT). If any of you have a conflict, call it out now.

Thanks — Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Exec sponsor dry‑run and gating sprint for Acme close

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 09:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
>
> Picking up from last week: Acme is asking for a short executive board (EB) validation week that will gate final approvals.

Thanks, Dylan — I pulled together the sponsor matrix and an agenda split that maps each EB topic to a primary and backup presenter. See ExecSponsor_Matrix.csv attached. Key callouts:

- Primary sponsor: Samantha Lowe (VP Product) will own 'Customer Adoption & Business Impact' section.
- Secondary sponsor: Raj Patel (Head of Eng) will own 'Performance & Ops' with prod-eng represented for technical Q/A.
- Redwood presenters proposed: Marissa (business value, adoption), Karthik (evaluation results + technical Q/A), Dylan (close ask & next steps).

I also added a separate DRY‑RUN agenda (EB_DryRun_Agenda.xlsx) with a 15‑minute choreography window at the start to walk through slide transitions and Q/A handoffs. I've flagged three questions for the sponsor to rehearse:

1) How does the evaluation mapping align to Acme's SLAs and the expected throughput?
2) What mitigations do we propose for latency outliers observed in the stress test?
3) What is the rollback plan / timeline if EB requests additional validation?

I'll take ownership of the sponsor outreach email to Samantha — drafting now and will ask for availability for the dry‑run (July 1 or 2).

Marissa
Sr. Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acme.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-22T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed dry‑run & EB timing + exec sponsor matrix (Acme Redwood MAP)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the productive evaluation meetings last week. We want to ensure the EB session is efficient and that your exec sponsors get a clean, confident narrative. Two asks:

1) Dry‑run with sponsors: proposed slots — Thurs, July 1 at 10:00 AM PT or Fri, July 2 at 9:00 AM PT (60 minutes). Purpose: walk through the slides, handoffs, and responses to the three gating questions.
2) EB meeting: Tues, July 6 at 9:00 AM PT (45 minutes). If that doesn't work, we can offer Wed, July 7 at 11:00 AM PT as a backup.

Attached: MAP_v3.pdf (mutual action plan with QA checkpoints), ExecSponsor_Matrix.csv (who presents what), and EB_DryRun_Agenda.xlsx (run order + timing).

High level: if the dry‑run validates the gates, we expect a conditional approval from EB on July 6 with a 2‑week operational window for any follow‑on items. If additional validation is requested, we'll escalate to a short technical sprint and schedule a focused follow‑up EB in two weeks.

Can you confirm the dry‑run slot that works for Samantha, Raj, and the prod‑eng lead? Also confirm whether Samantha wants any specific talking points added to the adoption slide.

Best —
Marissa
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>, prod-eng@acme.com
Date: 2027-06-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed dry‑run & EB timing + exec sponsor matrix (Acme Redwood MAP)

Marissa —

Thanks — July 1 at 10:00 AM PT for the dry‑run works for me and Raj. I've looped in our lead from prod‑eng (prod‑eng@acme.com) for the EB Q/A. Quick notes:

- Please make sure the 'performance & ops' slide includes the KV cache plan and the quantization profile used in the stress tests.
- We'll expect a short appendix on data retention and KMS integration for legal to glance at before EB.

We are okay with July 6 at 9:00 AM PT for the EB pending a successful dry‑run. If anything changes on our side I'll update the thread.

Samantha
VP, Product | Acme Corporation
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-26T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Dry‑run confirmed + owner checklist and next steps

All —

Dry‑run locked: July 1, 10:00 AM PT with Samantha and Raj. EB tentatively July 6, 9:00 AM PT. Short checklist before the dry‑run (owners):

- Slides: final slide deck + appendix on KMS/data retention (Marissa)
- Evaluation summary: top 5 test cases + pass/fail criteria (Karthik)
- Ops runbook excerpt & rollback timeline (Stephanie)
- Choreography: slide handoff notes + presenter timings (Marissa + Dylan)

I'll run the dry‑run choreography and own the final close ask slide. Please upload artifacts to the Drive link and confirm by EOD Monday so I can circulate the rehearsal deck.

Thanks — Dylan
